node.statement: Controlled exact-unit C*-rectification: there are universal C_rect >= 1 and e_rect in (0, 1/C_rect] such that every finite-dimensional epsilon_X-C*-algebra with 0 <= epsilon_X <= e_rect admits, on the same involutive normed space, a bilinear product bold-dot and J = J^dagger for which (calX, J, bold-dot, dagger) satisfies EVERY exact-unit epsilon_r-C*-algebra axiom of def-epsilon-cstar-algebra, including ||J|| = 1, where epsilon_r = C_rect*epsilon_X, and ||J - I_X|| <= C_rect*epsilon_X, ||x bold-dot y - xy|| <= C_rect*epsilon_X*||x||*||y||.
